scenes.title: The first car
scenes.text: In 1886, Karl Benz built the first practical petrol car. It had three wheels and went about sixteen kilometres an hour.

scenes.title: Cars for everyone
scenes.text: In 1908, Ford launched the Model T. Later, the assembly line made cars cheap enough for ordinary families.

scenes.title: Style era
scenes.text: The nineteen fifties brought chrome, big tail fins, and cars that were all about style.

scenes.title: Fuel crisis
scenes.text: In the nineteen seventies, an oil crisis made people want smaller cars that used less fuel.

scenes.title: The first hybrid
scenes.text: In 1997, the Toyota Prius arrived in Japan. It was the first mass produced hybrid car.

scenes.title: Electric gets fast
scenes.text: In 2008, the Tesla Roadster showed the world that electric cars could be fast.

scenes.title: Cars with brains
scenes.text: Today, cars get software updates, driver assist features, and cameras all around.

scenes.title: What is coming?
scenes.text: And the future? Self driving cars, maybe even flying taxis. Which car would you drive? Tell me in the comments.
